'''Smuggler's Run''' was a treacherous [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] that harbored a plethora of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and illegal activities, located near [[Wrea/Legends|Wrea]].

==History==
Only certain people (mainly [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]) knew how to find the Smuggler's Run. There were numerous inhabited [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], but the largest and most important was [[Skip 1]]. Navigating the asteroids was extremely hazardous, but [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] learned easily from [[Roa]] in his smuggling days.

This collection of asteroids was once controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. It served as a base of operations for many smugglers who couldn't afford the relative luxury of havens like [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The Smuggler's Run had been used for several centuries and remained unchecked due to its hazardous entrance through the asteroids. Several asteroids were hollowed out or riddled with caverns to support life, nicknamed Skips. The Skips were numbered in the order in which they were inhabited. A few minor crime lords developed personal empires within certain asteroids, but their influence rarely extended beyond a single rock.

After the deaths of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the Hutt and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Run was freed of Hutt control and began to operate on its own. During this time, the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kueller|Dolph]] found an ally in the [[Glottalphib]] crime lord [[Nandreeson]], and together they began shipping Dolph's rigged [[Droid/Legends|droids]] through the Run to points on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] worlds. Many smugglers took jobs working for Nandreeson and Dolph, but many of them suddenly disappeared when they got too involved. Dolph became known as Kueller, and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] followed clues to Smuggler's Run following a bombing in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]].
